abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) appearances of a case with rare solid mature teratoma of the ovary is presented. The lesion was almost entirely solid with small cystic component. The solid tissue, consisting of bronchial cartilage, smooth muscle, glands, and epithelium, exhibited hypointense signal on T1-weighted image, relatively hyperintense signal on T2-weighted image, and reticular pattern of enhancement on the postcontrast scan. The presence of fatty tissue mixed with hair bundle, which did not exhibit a signal intensity of fatty tissue, was clearly indicated by chemical shift artifact within the cystic component.
abstract_ja: 稀な卵巣の充実性成熟奇形腫の症例について、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見を示す。病変はほぼ全体が充実性で、嚢胞成分は小さかった。充実部は気管支軟骨、平滑筋、腺組織、上皮から構成され、T1強調像で低信号、T2強調像で比較的高信号を示し、造影後は網状の増強パターンを呈した。嚢胞成分内では、毛髪束を伴う脂肪様組織が認められ、脂肪組織の信号強度を示さなかったが、化学シフトアーチファクトにより明瞭に示された。
